name: cloudflare_delete_dns_record
description: Delete a DNS record by id (HTTP DELETE). IRREVERSIBLE — the record is removed from live DNS immediately, which can take a subdomain, site, or mail offline. Requires `zone_id` and `record_id`. Always confirm the record_id maps to the exact record the user means (use cloudflare_get_dns_record first) before calling this.

zone_id.description: The zone id the record belongs to.

record_id.description: The DNS record id to delete.
